Run twice: node scripts/debug/so-scenario.mts run test/scenarios/live-v24-08-routing.json --sandbox --group 1759606632088; diff a run header around it (extraction.profiles must read back as before: the runner's extraction restore covers profiles). Routes speaker direction to the memory model's own profile id through the role map (source role, not fallback), runs the director self-test from the settings panel (3 labelled director.json cases must parse), plays a real turn and requires a talk decision with the route healthy, then points the curator at a profile id that does not exist and requires the Repair row for it (area model-role, the curator consequence), and finally clears the role map. A second live profile is not assumed.
